<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$reconcile-project-sources</code></p>

Compare shared and private project sources, explain meaningful drift, and plan explicit promotion, relocation, rebind, cutover, or preservation. Use when OpenSpec, changelog, or todo sources overlap without automatic merging.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link reconcile-project-sources --scope user
arcantry skills link reconcile-project-sources --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link reconcile-project-sources --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `changelog`, `todo-txt`.

## Learning outcomes

- Explain source drift without merging configurations or exposing private content.
- Plan a verified promotion or relocation with explicit deletion boundaries.

## Examples

### Promote private project intent

**Prompt**

> Use $reconcile-project-sources to compare the private and shared intent sources and prepare a safe promotion plan.

**Expected outcome**

A reviewed plan identifies semantic drift, the target authority, verification, and any separate deletion.

### Preserve divergent task queues

**Prompt**

> Use $reconcile-project-sources to inspect shared and private todo queues without automatically merging them.

**Expected outcome**

Each queue remains independent and the report identifies only explicit actions the user may choose.
